messages:
ivy: spotted weird quota attribution — console shows project:alpha but org quota got charged. anyone else?
sam: saw spike in org quota dashboard too. any req id?
ivy: req=01HZA4X9T0B2QZ3C0YAB
leah: traced it. client sent x-project header, token claim missing project. auth resolver fell back to org-default.
sam: why are we falling back? thought we hardened that last quarter.
leah: fallback was permissive to avoid breaking older clients. but this silently moves cost to org.
ivy: can we flip behavior to fail when header present but token lacks claim?
leah: yes. propose feature-flag auth.strict_project_claims = true. gated rollout. also add metric auth.attribution_provenance = header|token|fallback.
sam: +1. add audit event when fallback is used. ops needs to triage billings.
leah: quick mitigation: patch edge to preserve x-project for multipart/form-data; longer fix: enable strict flag after canary tests.
devops-bot: incident INC-6876509123 created. owners: ivy, leah. runbook: http://runbooks/internal/auth-attrib
ivy: nate from Console, can you show both "client project" and "resolved project" in request detail UI to reduce confusion?
sam: we'll roll 1% -> 10% -> 100% if canary looks good. add circuit-breaker to revert on >1% 4xx increase.
leah: i'll add provenance tag, sampling at 1% initially, and the audit log event. posting PRs shortly.
ivy: thanks. will update CS note draft in #customer-impact.
